category_title: Dominant preschool children who frequently report peers' norm violations
scenario_title: Resource dispute and property entitlement during free play
minimal_context: Jack is participating in free play at the art and block stations with his peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jack, you and Matthew can use the building blocks to make a tower, or use the scissors and paintbrushes at the art table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Teacher, I want to paint but she’s not ﬁnished yet [with the paintbrush]; she won’t hurry up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just see if you can find something else to do while you wait.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks over to the blocks) Give me those blocks, Matthew. If you don't give them to me, I’m telling the teacher!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to play nicely and work it out together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Teacher! Matthew, he’s knocking down the tower! And he won’t let me have the scissors! You need to punish him!
